simple.summary: צָפוֹן (Tsâphôwn) means Tsaphon , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 13 27.

definitions.full: H6829. Tsaphon II. צָפוֺן proper name, of a location on east bank of Jordan, in tribe of Gad , ׳צ Josh 13:27 ( Σαφαν[ων] ), צָפ֫וֺנָה Judg 12:1 ( βοῤρἇν, ᵐ5 L Σεφηνα ); according to Talmud = modern Amateh , north of Jabbok, GFM Buhl Geogr. 259 (who doubts); ‚apuna appears Tel Amarna Wkl No. 174 .
